plan.notes: ABUS-GR in Business, General Requirements 'Course Sequence by Term' as published in the official 2026-2027 MCC pathway map (Academic Plan Code 8900), retrieved 2026-10-01. The map publishes two pacing variants (full-time Terms 1-4 and part-time Terms 1-10); this seed follows the full-time variant. Accounting sequencing uses the map's default generic 'Accounting Course' placeholder rows (the three track-specific variants - ACC111/ACC112/ACC212, ACC111/ACC230/ACC240, ACC211/ACC212 - are noted in the choice_note, not sequenced). Sequenced sum = 74 (20+16+19+19) using maximum printed credit values for range cells, per the range convention; the catalog prints Total Credits Required 60-64 and carries its own disclaimer that 'Course Sequence total credits may differ from the program information located on the MCCCD curriculum website due to program and system design.'
